_README: GOLDEN: the DEFAULT consensus board ordering (breadth, then net
conviction, then gross) on real data/ — the pre-W2b construction.
tests/test_etf_weighting.py replays `rows` through consensus_favored
and requires `ordering` back byte-identical, so the structural
weighting lens can never quietly re-sort the board (masterplan §0.6).
R1 LANDED 2026-08-12 (masterplan §6b): the VanEck cash-line fix is IN
these rows. `-USD CASH-` and its 18 sibling currency forms no longer
sit in the flow-normalization denominator, so GDX/GDXJ/REMX/SMH stopped
publishing phantom active changes and the board went 207 -> 200 names.
B1 LANDED 2026-08-12 (masterplan §6c): a positively-identified split
no longer counts on the ranked path. The live case is ARKW/CRWD 3:1 —
shares x2.977 at flat market value — which used to publish +207.93%
active change and +1.6274 conviction_pp. CRWD now reads n_accum 2 (was
3) and net 7.0916 (was 8.719) and sits at #15 (was #8); the seven names
it was outranking each move up one. Board size is unchanged at 200: the
split leg is set aside, the row's three real legs still carry it. The
ARKW leg stays in `funds` labeled `counted: false`.
Regenerate ONLY when the DEFAULT construction is deliberately changed
again — in that same commit, never ahead of it, because a fixture
regenerated early stops pinning anything.
Regenerate with: python3 tests/test_etf_weighting.py --regenerate
No engine SHA is recorded here (m16): the value could only ever be the
commit BEFORE the one that carries the fixture, so it named a tree in
which this file does not exist. The ruling above is the provenance.
Input is TICKER-SLICED to the names that make the board at
min_funds; consensus groups are independent per ticker, so dropping
other tickers cannot change the relative order of these.
`ladder` is omitted: carried onto the group, read by neither the
grouping nor the sort.
